name: Old Tomo
signatureQuote: "The tide doesn't lie. People do. Pay me and I'll tell you which is which."
physicalDescription: A wiry old man with salt-white braids, a patched oilskin coat and a ferry pole worn smooth by decades. One knuckle is always taped.
contradiction: Hates the Authority but ferries its wardens for free.
wants: Enough coin to retire to a dry-room.
actuallyNeeds: Someone to take over his ferry route before he drowns tired.

speech.tic: Taps his pole twice before answering

relationships.why: Trades gossip for tea every ninth day.
Owes them for the ferry hull.

dialogue.openingLine: "Fare's a coin or a secret. Pick one."

branches.reply: "Good. Where to? Mind the third pier."
"Hm. That's worth the whole trip and a warning."

questHook: Tomo needs someone to carry a sealed crate to Choir Shrine without asking what's in it.
designNotes: Good early-game guide; his rumors seed three districts.

name: Dr. Adaeze Ruvo
signatureQuote: "I've seen what water does to a lung. Don't tell me about brave."
physicalDescription: Tall, tired, forearms scarred with chemical burns. Her apron is stained a permanent grey-blue.
contradiction: Preaches free care while quietly stockpiling for a siege.
actuallyNeeds: Sleep, and someone to share the call-list.

relationships.why: Built it from a queue of corpses.

dialogue.openingLine: "Sit. Breathe. Then tell me what you took in."

branches.reply: "We'll see. Take off the glove."
"Name your price. I'll tell you if I can afford it."

questHook: A diver is stuck in the chamber; Ruvo needs a rare filter from the Trident Works without paying the Consortium.
designNotes: Moral anchor; shows the cost of the economy.

name: Kessa Marrow
signatureQuote: "You find it, I cut it loose, we split it. Unless you're slow."
physicalDescription: Compact woman, shaved temples, a bandolier of cutting tools and a smile that doesn't reach her eyes.
contradiction: Calls herself loyal to the Guild but is courting Trident.
actuallyNeeds: To be told she was good before the Master retires.

relationships.why: Hale taught her; she has surpassed him.

branches.reply: "Keep talking. It's the only part of you that's quick."
"Terms first. Then I decide if I like you."

questHook: She hires the party to beat a rival crew to a sunken tram.

name: One-Eyed Hale
signatureQuote: "I lost the eye to a Glimmer Eel. Best lesson I ever bought."
physicalDescription: Heavy, kind-faced, with a cloudy left eye and a harpoon-scar across the brow.
contradiction: Teaches safety while refusing to dive again.
wants: To see one more crew come home whole.
actuallyNeeds: Forgiveness for the diver he left behind.

relationships.why: He taught her everything and she knows it.

dialogue.openingLine: "Sit, sit. Mind the bucket — it's eel."

branches.reply: "Light means bait. Always. Remember that."
"Not before the second drink."

questHook: Hale knows the lane to a wreck no one has reached; he will map it only if someone brings back a keepsake.

name: Mama Quill
physicalDescription: Small and round, silver hair pinned with fishbones, always sewing something to someone's sleeve.

relationships.why: Her stall is the first on the row.

branches.reply: "Good. Now tell me who sent you."
"Hm. Proud. I like that. Eat anyway."

questHook: Quill asks the party to find a lost sewing kit that holds her husband's old dive logs.

name: Pip
signatureQuote: "I know a shortcut. It's only a little bit flooded."
physicalDescription: A bright kid in an oversized slicker with a satchel that clinks, bare feet, bandaged knees.
contradiction: Looks reckless but memorizes every tide table.

dialogue.openingLine: "Hey, hey! You're new. Want to see something cool?"

branches.reply: "This way! Duck at the cable."
"Okay but you'll miss the good one."

questHook: Pip finds a half-flooded chamber with a humming cable and needs the party to see it.
designNotes: Hook generator; can be killed for stakes.

name: Gran Oskar
signatureQuote: "I've outlived three seawalls. I'll outlive you too if you listen."
physicalDescription: Barrel-chested old man in a quilted vest, hands like roots, eyes pale as bleached shell.
contradiction: Believes the tide is a teacher but wants it stopped.
wants: To see a child of the Sprawl grow old.
actuallyNeeds: Someone to hand the ledger to.

dialogue.openingLine: "Sit down, boy. The tide's not in a hurry."

branches.reply: "It's every drowned name I know. Don't make me add yours."
"Bring me a lost cable-chart from the Mid-Stacks."

questHook: Oskar sends the party to recover the first tide-ledger from the Drowned Cathedral.
designNotes: Lore keeper; ties history to the world.

name: Brother Veyl
signatureQuote: "Silence has a shape. Come and be measured for it."
physicalDescription: Pale, gaunt man in a hooded robe sewn from cable-sheathing, a bone flute at his hip.
actuallyNeeds: To be forgiven by the one he was sent to kill.

dialogue.openingLine: "The water is listening. Please keep your voice low."

branches.reply: "We are tuning the city. Slowly."
"Laughter echoes. We prefer it not to."

questHook: Veyl offers the party a seat at the Choir if they carry a sealed reed to the Pale Listener.

name: Sgt. Taro Maka
signatureQuote: "Rules are the only thing between us and the lower levels."
physicalDescription: Square-jawed, armor patched in three colors, eyes always counting exits.
contradiction: Enforces orders he doesn't believe in.

dialogue.openingLine: "Papers. And your reason for being on my wall."

branches.reply: "Good. Keep your hands where I can see them."
"Don't insult me. Then do it again, politely."

questHook: Maka offers a deal: bring evidence on a corrupt warden and he drops charges against the party.

name: Warden Hsu
signatureQuote: "The Wall is a promise. I intend to keep it."
physicalDescription: Lean woman in a grey coat with brass epaulets, a prosthetic left hand etched with tide marks.
contradiction: Defends the Wall but quietly rations the lower districts.
actuallyNeeds: A reason to trust someone again.

speech.tic: Counts tide marks on her hand

dialogue.openingLine: "State your business. Be brief; the tide is not."

branches.reply: "Where. When. And who else knows?"
"Fill out the form. Then we discuss form."

questHook: Hsu asks the party to inspect a suspected breach in the Wall before the next high tide.

name: Iris Vandermeer
signatureQuote: "Everything has a price. I simply publish it."
physicalDescription: Immaculate in a pressure-suit-grey blazer, steel monocle, rings on every finger.
actuallyNeeds: Someone who isn't afraid of her.

dialogue.openingLine: "Welcome to the Works. May I interest you in a subscription?"

branches.reply: "The Standard tier covers eight hours. Eight and a half costs extra."
"Oh, you're one of those. Lovely."

questHook: Vandermeer hires the party to sabotage Mercy Drop's filter supply.

name: Capt. Rook Delacroix
signatureQuote: "Seven dives, one rule: nobody dies for a crate."
physicalDescription: Silver-haired, weathered, a bell-helmet under one arm and a necklace of dive tags.
contradiction: Brags about caution while taking worse risks each year.

dialogue.openingLine: "Gear up. The lane's open for exactly forty minutes."

branches.reply: "Good. Stay on the line."
"Smart. Come back when you're stupid."

questHook: Delacroix plans a deep dive to the Drowned Cathedral and needs a crew he can trust.

name: The Quiet Hand
signatureQuote: "Nobody ever saw me. That's the service."
physicalDescription: Unknown. Appears as a gloved hand sliding a note under a door.
wants: A buyer who doesn't ask questions.

speech.tic: Leaves a drawn eye on every note

dialogue.openingLine: (A note slides under the door: "Three coins. Third pier. Alone.")

branches.reply: "Good. Here is what I know."
The next note arrives anyway.

questHook: The Quiet Hand offers a map to the Syndicate vault in exchange for a favor to be named later.

name: Mother Sael
signatureQuote: "We do not pray for the water to leave. We pray to be worthy of it."
physicalDescription: Statuesque, in layered shroud-robes, voice like a cello, fingers stained with salt.
contradiction: Preaches quiet but orders the loudest chants.

branches.reply: "The Shrine keeps none, but the Choir keeps many."
"Not here. Not aloud."

questHook: Sael asks the party to escort a pilgrim past Syndicate patrols.

name: Sgt. Ahote Brant
signatureQuote: "I've held this line since before you could swim."
physicalDescription: Broad and calm, braided beard, a repaired shield strapped to his back.
contradiction: Hates the Authority's corruption but loves its mission.
actuallyNeeds: To tell someone the truth about the Level 3 breach.

branches.reply: "Thank you."
"Not here."

questHook: Brant secretly asks the party to inspect the Level 3 breach and keep it off the books.

name: Wren Zhao
physicalDescription: Thin, jittery, goggles pushed up into dyed-teal hair, cables trailing from her coat.
contradiction: Maps every secret but can't keep her own.
actuallyNeeds: To be seen as a person, not a lens.

dialogue.openingLine: "Don't move — you're standing on a sensor."

branches.reply: "Better. Now, favor?"
"Forty-two. Eleven lie."

questHook: Wren needs someone to place a signal booster inside the Hollow Choir's shrine.

name: Lucian Reyes
signatureQuote: "Everyone has a vice. I just supply it."
physicalDescription: Dapper, slicked hair, a rust-stained suit, a ring on every other finger.
contradiction: Smuggler with a soft spot for strays.
wants: To buy the Gate Four lease.
actuallyNeeds: Someone to tell him he's good.

speech.tic: Taps a ring on the table

dialogue.openingLine: "Welcome to Gate Four. Take a seat. Take a drink."

branches.reply: "Smart. What do you need?"
"Accusation is just another word for opening bid."

questHook: Reyes wants the party to deliver contraband across the Gate without scanning.

name: Chief Imani Okoro
signatureQuote: "We carry this city on our backs. Remember who carries who."
physicalDescription: Broad-shouldered, calloused, a red scarf tied at her neck, voice that cuts through crane noise.
contradiction: Fights for the union but hates strikes.
wants: A hazard clause for deep dives.

dialogue.openingLine: "Name's Okoro. You're either with us or in our way."

branches.reply: "Good. Dues are a day's pay."
"Then we'll see you on the pier."

questHook: Okoro asks the party to stop a scab shipment at Gate Four.
